receipt_after_close.inference_inputs: Only official normalized state/questions; no evaluation metadata or data files
receipt_after_close.native_component: Actual native systemOne executed every request; native original and baseline100 answers retained
receipt_after_close.architecture: Actual native RuVector ranking with unchanged epoch6 partition/packing algorithm, using a frozen active RoBERTa byte-level BPE token-budget adapter and the official fixed FP32 12-layer/768 SNLI+MultiNLI threeway reader. All3 retrieval arms share that exact tokenizer, algorithm and singleton reader. At most40 ranked anchors; immediate same-paragraph neighbors may be inspected identically under512 tokens. Legacy top2 names are variable-unit interface aliases. Native104 reads the same primary excerpt. Historical SentencePiece context strings are not preserved. No known accuracy superiority is claimed.

config.hypothesis: A distinct directly published RoBERTa SNLI+MNLI semantic/contradiction family may avoid the prior all-entailment/contradiction failure while fitting the CPU bound. No known accuracy superiority or stronger architecture claim. One fixed model, no search over variants.
config.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

source_partition.paragraph_boundary: blank-line break, including its exact whitespace
source_partition.atom_boundary: sentence or semicolon followed by whitespace
source_partition.oversize_policy: Explicit observed NLI token-offset fallback, complete source retained

config.ranking_depth_scope: min(40, total_units) anchor candidates for native, lexical and positional arms; same-paragraph neighbor expansion may inspect additional units under the same512-token budget
config.packing: Scan ranked anchors; add complete anchor if it fits, then previous and next same-paragraph units if they fit; concatenate merged selected spans in source order
config.decoder: Official fixed FP32 12-layer768 RoBERTa, C0/E1/N2 threeway softmax,T1;Yes=E;No=C+N;exact.5tieNo
config.legacy_arm_names: ruvector_top2/same_nli_lexical_top2/same_nli_positional_first2 are interface aliases; epoch6 ranks up to40 anchor candidates, may inspect same-paragraph neighbors outside that ranking, and packs a variable number identically under512 tokens
config.context_selection: Exact reviewed epoch6 source partition/anchors/neighbors/source-order packing algorithm and numeric coverage audit, with new active RoBERTa BPE used for all NLI token budgets before measurements. BGE guards unchanged. No truncation/padding/tokenizer rescue.
config.confirmation_separation: DEV24/8groups role-frozen before single model choice; TRAIN/calibration empty. Existing project-model-unused48 confirmation bank remains gated; no confirmation labels read, no supervised ContractNLI declared, unknown pretraining overlap.

nli.source_policy: Exact epoch6 partition/packing algorithm with active RoBERTa BPE token-budget adapter
